decisions_requested.statement: Approve QA-001 as a name exchange using KALA YA EN ES KU KE as a validated whole utterance, without assigning token-level meanings to YA or ES.
Approve QA-002 as an age exchange using EN KU SARASALA KE plus CARDINAL_0_99 responses, preserving SARASALA=WATCH, numeral primitives=CANDIDATE and the scoped 10-99 course composition.
Approve QA-003 as a birthplace exchange using EN SARADAYA KUVAN KE plus a bare PLACE response, preserving KUVAN=CANDIDATE and no universal locative grammar claim.
Approve QA-004 as a hobbies exchange using EN KU VAMAVALA KE plus a governed hobby/activity response, preserving VAMAVALA=WATCH and KU's unrecovered exact historical WH gloss.
Confirm all four current Q&A items are new SimpleWay HNK v1.1 pedagogical authorship and not recovered historical Q&A payload.

explicit_non_effects: Does not create new HNK lexical forms.
Does not create new HNK grammar rules.
Does not promote WATCH, GATE or CANDIDATE assets.
Does not assign meanings to YA or ES.
Does not promote Q&A slots to FROZEN.
application_rule: Do not transition the four Q&A slots to VALIDATED until all five scoped decisions are explicitly approved.
